title: Observational Indistinguishability and Integrity Blind Regions in Hybrid Quantum-Classical Workflows
description: Version 1.3.5 adds one preregistered geometry-aligned sensitivity analysis to resolve the relationship between clean-resample calibration and same-item intervention scoring. No dataset, model family, kernel, feature map, hyperparameter search, threat class, formal theorem or primary structural experiment was changed. All version 1.3.4 scientific evidence remains byte-identical; the new sensitivity evidence is stored and manifested separately. The sensitivity deterministically replays the frozen configurations across all eight environments and shows that the matched monitor-aware intervention consistently reduces response while retaining materiality under aligned geometry. The formal core is unchanged. The release also bounds minimum evidence granularity to the declared reference lattice, clarifies compact authenticated representations and trusted-aggregate generation, and updates the manuscript and submission package. Contents include code, tests, nine SHA-256 evidence manifests, compact derived evidence, bibliography audits, figures, formal core, adversary model, manuscript sources and submission PDFs.
